    How these numbers work

    Magnific sells video through monthly allowances of credits, not a price per second. Every price on this page is worked out from Magnific's own USD plan data: the plan price, the credits it includes, and the credits each clip uses.

    PlanPriceCredits a month$ per unitChecked

    ModelClip lengthCredits per clipClips a month on Premium (annual)Clips a month on Premium+ (annual)Clips a month on Pro (annual)

    MiniMax H3 Max Turbo5s200100250625
    • Price per second = plan price per month ÷ credits a month × credits per clip ÷ clip length in seconds. The 10-second cost is that rate × 10. A model whose longest clip is shorter than 10 seconds needs more than one clip, and the row says how many.
    • Magnific's pricing page states the credits each model uses per clip, so these rows use stated numbers. Annual plans grant the year's credits up front, valid for one year; the monthly figure is the yearly total ÷ 12.
    • Example: MiniMax H3 Max Turbo on Pro (annual) is $82.50/mo ÷ 125,000 credits = $0.00066 per unit; × 200.0 credits per 5s clip = $0.132 a clip; ÷ 5 seconds = $0.0264/s. That plan's 125,000 credits make about 625 such clips a month.
    • Every row on this page assumes every credit you pay for is used. Unused credits make the real cost per second higher.
    • A sale plan shows its regular price next to it. When the sale ends, the sale labels go away and the next daily check moves the rows to the regular plan price once Magnific's page shows it.
    • Magnific also bills these plans monthly. Our price data has only the annual plan cards, so monthly billing is not priced here. Only models VidFare covers are listed.
    • This page rebuilds with every daily price check. If any row on it goes more than 7 days without a check, the page shows a notice and is hidden from search until it is re-checked. Oldest check on this page: Nov 22, 2026.
